name: Arugula
description: Peppery leaf served in bunches on the mezze table.

tcm.note: No Chinese entry; the mustard-family pungency reads warm.

unani.note: Jarjeer is documented as garam-khushk and reputed as an aphrodisiac.

guna.note: Fresh and simple — the sattvic default for plant food eaten close to how it grew.

effects.note: Also nitrate-dense; a randomised trial comparing rocket, spinach, and beetroot juice as nitrate sources found arugula lowered blood pressure at least as well as the other two, with the drop in diastolic pressure lasting longer. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
